Without a website, a distinguishing address, or any other lead in the source data, and with this registrys WebSearch tool exhausted for the duration of this project, attempting to attribute an operator to any of these names individually would require guessing at a real-world entity from a bare, often generic name (several, such as MDC, IT, and Datacenter, are single words or acronyms with no unique identifying value at all), which this registrys policy against matching entities on name alone and against fabricating unverified facts both prohibit. No operator attribution is made for any of these 55 facilities and none is fabricated; each remains an open research item that a future session with a working search tool, or manual human lookup, may be able to resolve.

reading.body:
This facility's published power specifications are not available in the data provided. The address places it in Piscataway, New Jersey, within Middlesex County, but the operator details and power capacity cannot be confirmed from the source listed.

New Jersey has 48 mapped data center facilities across the state, of which only five publish power capacity figures totaling 111.3 MW. This campus ranks sixth by published megawatts in the state, which means it either publishes a capacity below the fifth-ranked facility or is included in the ranking despite having no published specification in the current dataset, indicating a data inconsistency that requires resolution.

Without published power specifications, IT load, or certification details, this facility cannot be assessed for its relevance to AI infrastructure scaling. The research status is marked exhausted, meaning standard lookups have not returned operator-level details or technical specifications beyond the address.
